name: Salamander
skills: Stealth, Alertness, Athletics, Acrobatics; Acuity, Standing, Mastery, Expert, Innate Skill, Greater Endurance (Vigor), Fighting Blind
notes: Dokugiri: standard-action ninjutsu, 5 chakra, standard cone, instant; venom reservoir 1 compartment per size category; poisoning up to IV above Medium and up to V with Kuchiyose 10 and Elite Chemist; expel poison, then 5-round cooldown. Swallowing: full action while immersed, successful Stealth then grapple sneak attack against smaller creature directly above; swallowed victim has weakened attack and defense; automatic failure on Stamina tests to resist internal venom each round. Escape via contested CC/Strength or Escape against 4 + attacker critical control points. Bladed/piercing weapons can damage salamander on escape. Replaces Immerse False Decapitation.
prerequisite: One salamander per scene; maximum Huge size. Dokugiri requires Kuchiyose 6.
